subject: Marketplace renewal / PO timing and requested capacity increase
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement - Lumen Health <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace renewal / PO timing and requested capacity increase

Hi team — following our renewal call yesterday, two quick items I wanted to get on the record so we can lock the PO timing and acceptance window: 

1) Lumen is moving forward with the AWS Marketplace private offer. Procurement indicated you plan to issue a PO this month; can you confirm target PO issuance date and whether the PO will be a single-tranche or split into two invoices?

2) Customer requested a 25% capacity uplift on the Dedicated GPU pool starting day 1 of the renewal term. We attached a simple capacity schedule (capacity_uplift_schedule.xlsx) to show proposed ramp (month 0: +25%, month 3: +50%, month 6: +100% of uplift). If you need pricing broken into two tranches (one for baseline acceptance, one for uplift), say so and we’ll split the invoice.

Next steps we’d like: confirmation of PO issuance week (target), name and email for DocuSign signer, and any procurement-specific billing instructions (PO number format, tax exemption docs).

Attachments: lumen_po_draft_v3.pdf (draft PO for review), capacity_uplift_schedule.xlsx (ramp plan)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate legal handoff once we have the PO.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

From: Procurement - Lumen Health <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CFO - Lumen Health <cfo@lumenhealth.com>, CloudOps - Lumen Health <cloudops@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal / PO timing and requested capacity increase

Stephanie — thanks for the note and the draft. A few clarifying items from procurement: 

• PO timing: target issuance week is Nov 20–24. We expect a single PO but will consider a two-invoice approach if it reduces accounting friction.
• Invoice tranches: accounting prefers a fiscal split (FY28 tranche + FY29 tranche). If Redwood can present a two-invoice option tied to acceptance milestones, that will help.
• Signer: CFO (Maria J. Ortega) will sign, but procurement needs the final DocuSign envelope routed to procurement@lumenhealth.com for our records before routing to the CFO.
• Compliance: please confirm we will get SOC2 evidence and retention policy (we already have prior artifacts but need confirmation for the renewed term).

Also, CloudOps flagged a request: can Redwood provide a brief blast-radius note on the capacity uplift (what switchovers look like from our side)? CloudOps@lumenhealth.com

We’ll route the PO once accounting confirms the split is representable in our ERPs.

—Procurement Team
Lumen Health
procurement@lumenhealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement - Lumen Health <procurement@lumenhealth.com>, CloudOps - Lumen Health <cloudops@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 13:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal / PO timing and requested capacity increase

Hi Maria / CloudOps — looping in legal/solutions to address the two asks. Quick answers below and next steps: 

1) Two-invoice option: we can provide a split-invoice model that ties the second tranche to the acceptance of the uplift ramp (month 3 acceptance milestone). We will produce two invoice line items in the DocuSign/PO flow (tranche A: baseline term, tranche B: uplift schedule).

2) SOC2 & retention: Redwood will provide the current SOC2 Type II report and a retention summary during the renewal — I’ve attached the standard evidence link to our drive in the related_links section and will push the artifact to procurement inbox once legal confirms the latest PDF.

3) Blast-radius / capacity switchovers: short note for CloudOps — uplift is non-disruptive; we allocate capacity from reserved pools and autoscale to the uplift profile. There is no customer-side disruption or DNS change. If you want a short runbook for your ops team, I can send a 1-page playbook by EOD.

Next step: Marcus, can you review the PO language we put in the attached lumen_po_draft_v3.pdf for any legal catches? Ben, can you confirm pricing split for tranche B? Procurement, if Nov 20–24 is still good we’ll prep DocuSign and route it to procurement@lumenhealth.com first.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: CFO - Lumen Health <cfo@lumenhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement - Lumen Health <procurement@lumenhealth.com>, CloudOps - Lumen Health <cloudops@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal / PO timing and requested capacity increase

Kimberly / Stephanie — I’ve reviewed with accounting. We will sign provided two items are updated in the PO language: 

1) Term adjustment: CFO approval contingent on an 18-month term instead of 12 months given anticipated multi-year project needs. Please confirm pricing and pro-rata calculation for the extended term; we expect a consolidated billing view.
2) SLA note: we require the standard 99.9% availability SLA and a 30-day remediation credit clause written into Schedule A.

If Redwood can produce an updated PO that reflects the 18-month term and the tranche split for FY28/FY29 accounting, I will route sign-off to procurement and instruct them to issue the official PO the week of Nov 20.

—Maria Ortega
CFO, Lumen Health
cfo@lumenhealth.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: CFO - Lumen Health <cfo@lumenhealth.com>, Procurement - Lumen Health <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal / PO timing and requested capacity increase

Maria — appreciate the quick review and clear asks. Confirming next steps and what you’ll see in the updated package: 

• We will produce an updated PO/DocuSign envelope today that shows an 18-month term with clear pro-rata math (annualized rate and the FY28/FY29 tranche split).
• Schedule A will include the 99.9% SLA and a 30-day remediation credit clause (legal to confirm exact language; Marcus is on copy).
• DocuSign routing: we will send the envelope first to procurement@lumenhealth.com (for records) and then to Maria Ortega for signature. DocuSign link will be included in this thread.
• Attachments: once legal finalizes, we’ll attach lumen_signed_po_20281116.pdf to this thread and provide the SOC2 artifact link.

Ben and Marcus will push the updated PO and the split-invoice presentation into DocuSign today so you can route it during the Nov 20–24 window. If procurement needs a preview PDF earlier, say the word and I’ll send it over.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0143
